D.t: Jamie Ager leads by 4.0 in the forecast and wins 76% of simulations. The cushion is about 12,605 votes; a one point swing is about 1,580 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +3.3 and D +11.4. A normal polling error decides it.
